title: Tajanda Manor V5 · Exterior & Atmosphere Brief

hero.title: Tajanda Manor · The Dreamcatcher Sanctum
hero.subtitle: An Italianate scholar manor frozen in time, standing at No.27 inside a modern north-district neighborhood of New Miri.

items.label: Core contrast: old manor vs modern street

labeled.label: Logline
labeled.value: A cultured Italianate manor sits quietly in the center of an ordinary city block; inside, the afterimage of Tajanda's impossible ascension still leaks into modern life.

items.title: Tajanda is a Western prodigy scholar
items.body: He comes from a Western magical lineage but reverse-engineers Eastern cultivation with strict academic methods: notebooks, experiments, and archival logic. He eventually survives a ninefold tribulation and ascends, tearing open a cross-system rift.

items.title: This is a manor, not a wizard tower
items.body: Main body is 2 floors + attic in horizontal Italianate massing: low-pitched roof, broad eaves with brackets, stucco walls, tall arched windows, and a square belvedere.

items.title: Embedded in a normal city street
items.body: The manor is not on a cliff or in a forest. It is surrounded by ordinary two-story homes, convenience stores, parked cars, utility poles, and old neighborhood routines.

items.title: Arthur lives with distance and pragmatism
items.body: Arthur does not continue Tajanda's research. He simply occupies an uncleaned scholar ruin and uses what remains to protect people from failed by-products of old experiments.

items.title: Old-photo silhouette in a color city
items.body: From far away, No.27 rises one full level above neighboring 1980s-90s houses. The belvedere and low roofline read immediately as an architectural outsider.

items.title: Rust iron and ivy-bricked enclosure
items.body: A 1.8m red-brick wall with black rusted ironwork frames the front yard. Ivy partially overtakes the wall and can emit faint cyan phosphorescence at night.

items.title: Lived-in, never restored
items.body: Mailbox overstuffed with decades of flyers, rope-tied gate, old bicycle, random parcels, and temporary potted succulents over a boarded well keep the scene grounded and humane.

items.label: Cinnabar bagua over the door pediment
One bracket carved as seal script

items.title: Highest on 2F lab zone
items.body: Trace density decays from the second-floor experiment area to other main rooms, and is nearly absent in side wings.

items.title: Collected samples, not themed decor
items.body: Eastern elements read like a 19th-century scholar's research artifacts placed among Italianate furnishings, never as a full 'Eastern room'.

items.title: Occasional atmospheric residues
items.body: Pale red mist from the belvedere opening at night; brief unnatural quiet during peach blossom season; street animals stopping at the gate then avoiding entry.

ol: City night base: sodium street lights around 2200K, cool store LEDs around 6500K, and warm residential windows near 3000K.
Manor behavior: mostly dark mass with only one or two warm windows (kitchen, clinic, occasional attic points).
Twilight signature: strongest story moment; the peachwood sword silhouette is most legible against the late magenta sky.
Interior modernization clue: antique brass gas lamps rewired with modern electric bulbs by Arthur.

items.title: Keep the Italianate identity intact
items.body: Horizontal symmetry, low roof with decorative brackets, stucco age, arched windows, and central belvedere must remain the core architectural language.

items.title: No Gothic and no cliff tower fantasy
items.body: Ban spires, flying buttresses, gargoyles, stained-glass rose windows, and isolated mountain-tower framing.

items.title: Show modern life frictions
items.body: Utility poles, convenience-store spill light, wired lamp retrofits, tied gate rope, and neglected mail establish the current lived reality.

items.title: No flashy cultivation VFX
items.body: Avoid glowing talismans, floating blades, and active spell circles. Eastern traces should feel extinguished, archived, and residue-like.
